title: Be notified of hold expiry (Event Coordinator)
note: Test-first authoring 4 Nov 2026 (iteration 1 red run: ai/runtime/test-cycles/SPM-134/red-run; iteration 2 red run for the AC11 and expired-timestamp tests: red-run-02). 68 HOLD-EXP-NOTIF ids, all PRIMARY and approved by the story owner chaw678 on 4 Nov 2026 (AC11 is story-owner directed); Confluence matrix 41582744 and case pages HOLD-EXP-NOTIF-01 to 11 (folder 41156807). Shared files use titleMatch ^HOLD-EXP-NOTIF- so other stories' tests in them are not in scope. Spec decisions SC-SPM134-01 (expiry date format), 02 (reassignment marks the previous Coordinator's unread hold notices read) and 03 (a released hold's details show its expiry) were accepted by chaw678 on 4 Nov 2026; Jira AC4, AC6 and the new AC11 carry the story owner's changes (the expired notice is stamped with the hold's expiry time; a converted hold shows no expiry). Stacked on SPM-165 (hold notice pattern, /bookings?booking= link, read-only dialog), SPM-133 (expiry processor, scheduler) and SPM-132 (release and convert). SPM-165 tests VENUE-HOLD-NOTIF-03-I and 03-J were changed for this story. The browser cases (06-INT-1, 06-INT-2) run through backend/scripts/testing/run-browser.mjs fixtures with the backend started with TENTATIVE_HOLD_EXPIRY_INTERVAL_MS=1000; a cycle run seeds them first with `backend/scripts/testing/spm134-hold-fixtures.mjs seed`, exports the printed variables plus PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL and PLAYWRIGHT_API_URL, runs the cycle with the real-database suites on a different database from the browser backend, and removes the rows with `... cleanup` (documented in frontend/README.md). Mutants: backend spm134.mutants.mjs (36) and frontend spm134.mutants.mjs (8); the unrendered NotificationItem icon has no mutant. linesFrom changed-lines needs the story's commits, so G5 on changed lines can only run after the work is committed. SC-SPM134-05 (a reminder that finds no Coordinator is consumed, pinned by 09-E) and the SC-SPM134-01 addendum (September renders as "Sept") were decided by chaw678 on 4 Nov 2026. The e2e suite restores every venue_bookings row and notification it did not create (F-02).
